status: post hoc exact-joint-target recovery for SBC cases with intractable nuisance averaging
target: p(theta, z | x) proportional to p(theta) phi(z) times Gaussian observation likelihood, with z the standard-normal base of the simulator nuisance realization
reference: Del Moral, Doucet and Jasra (2006), Sequential Monte Carlo samplers, doi:10.1111/j.1467-9868.2006.00553.x
nuisance_move_reference: Cotter, Roberts, Stuart and White (2013), MCMC Methods for Functions, doi:10.1214/13-STS421
theta_proposal_scale: 2.38/sqrt(3) times covariance of current theta particles, adjusted to 23.4% acceptance
low_ancestor_recovery: Rerun with four times as many particles and three rejuvenation sweeps per stage; mark the case incomplete if fewer than 100 initial ancestors remain.
routing: Any pair using joint SMC fallback is excluded from SBI routing
limitations: Finite-particle SMC approximates the exact joint target; validate against exact rejection on a tractable case before accepting SBC recovery.
